paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks that require understanding existing source code, including behavior prediction, function explanation, debugging, and code review. However, aggregate benchmark accuracy can conceal how model reliability changes as source code becomes structurally more complex. This paper presents a complexity-aware framework for evaluating LLM code comprehension using cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume. We evaluate DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and Llama through two complementary tasks: automatic input–output prediction over 300 Python functions and manually assessed semantic comprehension over a balanced subset of 60 functions. The functions are grouped into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves an overall automatic accuracy of 78.33%, compared with 70.33% for Llama. However, accuracy decreases substantially from Low to High complexity, from 93.52% to 52.78% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 87.04% to 47.22% for Llama. Incorrect predictions are consistently associated with higher values of all four complexity metrics, and correlation and logistic-regression analyses confirm broadly comparable negative associations between structural complexity and correctness. Manual semantic comprehension shows the same degradation pattern, with accuracy decreasing from 100.00% to 75.00% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 90.00% to 60.00% for Llama. These findings demonstrate that complexity-aware evaluation provides a more diagnostic assessment of LLM code-comprehension reliability than aggregate accuracy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于需要理解现有源代码的软件工程任务，包括行为预测、函数解释、调试和代码审查。 然而，综合基准测试的准确率可能掩盖了模型可靠性如何随着源代码结构复杂性的增加而变化的情况。 本文提出了一种考虑复杂性的框架，用于评估 LLM 的代码理解能力，该框架采用了圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积等指标。 我们通过两项互补的任务对 DeepSeek-Coder-V2 和 Llama 进行了评估：在 300 个 Python 函数上执行自动输入-输出预测，以及对 60 个函数的平衡子集进行人工语义理解评估。 这些函数被分为低、中、高复杂度三个等级。 DeepSeek-Coder-V2 的自动预测整体准确率为 78.33%，而 Llama 的准确率为 70.33%。 然而，从低复杂度到高复杂度，准确率显著下降：DeepSeek-Coder-V2 的准确率从 93.52% 降至 52.78%，Llama 的准确率则从 87.04% 降至 47.22%。 错误的预测始终与所有四个复杂度指标的高值相关，相关性分析和逻辑回归分析也证实了结构复杂性与正确性之间存在大致相当的负相关关系。 人工语义理解也表现出相同的性能下降模式：DeepSeek-Coder-V2 的准确率从 100.00% 降至 75.00%，Llama 的准确率则从 90.00% 降至 60.00%。 这些发现表明，与仅依赖综合准确率相比，考虑复杂性的评估方法能更准确地诊断 LLM 代码理解能力的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering tasks that require understanding existing source code [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Beyond code generation, developers use LLMs to explain functions, predict program behavior, reason about edge cases, summarize implementation logic, and support debugging and code review [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . These tasks differ from code synthesis because they require the model to interpret the control flow, internal state, and behavior of an existing program. Consequently, code-generation performance alone does not fully characterize the reliability of LLMs in practical software engineering workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于需要理解现有源代码的软件工程任务中 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 除了代码生成，开发者还利用 LLM 来解释函数、预测程序行为、分析边界情况、总结实现逻辑，并支持调试和代码审查 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 这些任务与代码合成不同，因为它们要求模型能够解读现有程序的流程控制、内部状态和行为。 因此，仅凭代码生成性能无法全面反映 LLM 在实际软件工程工作流程中的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Code-comprehension difficulty is not uniform across programs. A function containing a single condition is generally easier to interpret than one with multiple branches, nested loops, interacting variables, and alternative execution paths [ 9 , 10 ] . As structural complexity increases, the model must track more control-flow decisions, intermediate states, boundary conditions, and symbolic operations. Aggregate accuracy can therefore conceal the conditions under which comprehension begins to fail [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 代码理解难度在不同程序之间并不一致。 包含单个条件的函数通常比包含多个分支、嵌套循环、相互作用的变量和替代执行路径的函数更容易理解 [ 9 , 10 ] 。 随着结构复杂性的增加，模型必须跟踪更多的控制流决策、中间状态、边界条件和符号运算。 因此，整体准确率可能会掩盖理解能力开始失效的具体条件 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks provide important foundations for evaluating programming-oriented LLMs. HumanEval [ 12 ] and MBPP [ 13 ] are widely used for code generation and program synthesis, while APPS [ 14 ] and CodeContests [ 15 ] contain more demanding programming problems. CRUXEval [ 11 ] and BigCodeBench [ 16 ] extend evaluation toward code reasoning, execution, and realistic function usage. However, benchmark-level scores are commonly reported without considering the structural complexity distribution of the evaluated functions. A benchmark dominated by simple functions may therefore overestimate model reliability on structurally demanding code.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试为评估面向编程的大型语言模型提供了重要的基础。 HumanEval [ 12 ] 和 MBPP [ 13 ] 被广泛用于代码生成和程序合成，而 APPS [ 14 ] 和 CodeContests [ 15 ] 则包含更具挑战性的编程问题。 CRUXEval [ 11 ] 和 BigCodeBench [ 16 ] 将评估范围扩展到了代码推理、执行以及真实场景中的函数使用。 然而，基准测试级别的分数通常在未考虑所评估函数结构复杂度的分布情况的情况下被报告出来。 因此，一个以简单函数为主的基准测试可能会高估模型在处理结构复杂代码时的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies have shown that LLM-generated code can contain semantic, logical, and algorithmic defects even when it appears syntactically plausible [ 17 ] . Reinforcement-learning-based prompt optimization has also demonstrated that code-generation performance depends on how programming tasks are formulated [ 18 ] , while complexity-aware feedback has connected code complexity with generation success [ 19 ] . These studies motivate evaluation beyond aggregate correctness, but they primarily examine generated-code quality and prompt-based improvement. The effect of structural complexity on comprehension of existing source code remains less directly investigated.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，即使大型语言模型生成的代码在语法上看似合理，也可能存在语义、逻辑和算法方面的缺陷 [ 17 ] 。 基于强化学习的提示优化也证明，代码生成性能取决于编程任务的表述方式 [ 18 ] ，而考虑复杂性的反馈则将代码复杂性与生成成功联系起来 [ 19 ] 。 这些研究推动了超越整体正确性的评估方法，但它们主要关注生成代码的质量以及基于提示的改进。 结构复杂性对现有源代码理解的影响，目前尚未得到直接的充分研究。

paragraphs.en: This paper addresses this gap through a complexity-aware evaluation method for LLM code comprehension. Each Python function is annotated using cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume, and is assigned to a Low-, Medium-, or High-complexity band. The method combines two complementary tasks: automatic input–output prediction, in which the model predicts the exact return value of a concrete function call, and manual semantic comprehension, in which the model answers questions about function purpose, intermediate variable roles, or edge-case behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过一种考虑复杂性的 LLM 代码理解评估方法来解决这一空白。 每个 Python 函数都使用循环复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积进行标注，并被分配到低、中或高复杂度等级。 该方法结合了两项互补的任务：自动输入-输出预测（模型预测具体函数调用的精确返回值）和手动语义理解（模型回答有关函数目的、中间变量作用或边界情况行为的问题）。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: A complexity-aware method that combines automatic behavioral prediction with manual semantic comprehension.
paragraphs.zh: 一种具备复杂性感知能力的结合方法，它将自动行为预测与人工语义理解相结合。

paragraphs.en: An analysis of how benchmark composition and structural complexity influence observed LLM comprehension accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 对基准测试的组成和结构复杂性如何影响所观察到的 LLM 理解准确性的分析。

paragraphs.en: Statistical evidence relating structural complexity metrics to incorrect predictions and complexity-related degradation across both evaluation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 统计证据表明，结构复杂度指标与错误预测以及两项评估任务中由复杂度引发的性能退化均存在关联。

paragraphs.en: The study is guided by the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 本研究由以下研究问题指导：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How does the complexity distribution of benchmark sources influence observed LLM comprehension performance?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：基准来源的复杂性分布如何影响所观察到的 LLM 理解性能？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Which structural complexity metrics are associated with incorrect LLM comprehension predictions?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题2：哪些结构复杂度指标与错误的 LLM 理解预测相关？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Does manual semantic comprehension reveal the same complexity-related reliability limitations observed in automatic input–output prediction?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3：手动语义理解是否揭示了与自动输入-输出预测中观察到的相同复杂性相关的可靠性限制？

paragraphs.en: Recent research has increasingly moved beyond code-generation accuracy to examine whether LLMs can reason about the behavior and meaning of existing programs. CRUXEval [ 11 ] evaluates input and output prediction over short Python functions and shows that strong performance on generation benchmarks does not necessarily transfer to execution reasoning. CodeMind [ 20 ] further separates independent execution, dependent execution, and specification reasoning, reporting that models become less reliable when programs contain non-trivial control flow, arithmetic operations, complex data types, or API calls. These studies establish that code reasoning is distinct from code synthesis, but they characterize difficulty mainly through task design rather than explicit structural-complexity bands.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已逐渐超越代码生成准确性，转而探讨大型语言模型（LLM）是否能够推理现有程序的行为和含义。 CRUXEval [ 11 ] 通过评估短小 Python 函数的输入与输出预测能力，表明在生成基准测试中的优异表现并不必然能迁移到执行推理任务中。 CodeMind [ 20 ] 进一步将执行推理划分为独立执行、依赖执行和规格推理，并指出当程序包含非平凡的流程控制、算术运算、复杂数据类型或 API 调用时，模型的可信度会下降。 这些研究确立了代码推理与代码合成属于不同任务，但它们主要通过任务设计来描述难度，而非通过明确的结构复杂度分级。

paragraphs.en: Other benchmarks broaden code comprehension beyond exact output prediction. CRQBench [ 21 ] evaluates natural-language questions derived from code-review comments and demonstrates that even advanced models can produce incorrect or weakly grounded explanations. LiveCodeBench [ 22 ] provides a continuously updated, contamination-resistant evaluation covering generation, execution, self-repair, and test-output prediction, while BigCodeBench [ 16 ] emphasizes realistic function calls, library usage, and more demanding programming instructions. These benchmarks improve realism and coverage, but their primary objective is broad capability assessment rather than determining how comprehension changes as the internal structure of an individual function becomes more complex.
paragraphs.zh: 其他基准测试将代码理解的范围扩展到了精确预测输出之外。 CRQBench [ 21 ] 评估源自代码审查评论的自然语言问题，并表明即使是先进模型也可能生成错误或缺乏充分依据的解释。 LiveCodeBench [ 22 ] 提供了一个持续更新且抗污染的评价体系，涵盖生成、执行、自我修复和测试输出预测；而 BigCodeBench [ 16 ] 则强调真实的函数调用、库的使用以及更具挑战性的编程指令。 这些基准测试提升了真实性和覆盖范围，但它们的主要目标是评估综合能力，而非确定当单个函数的内部结构变得更为复杂时，其理解能力会发生怎样的变化。

sents.zh: CRQBench [ 21 ] 评估源自代码审查评论的自然语言问题，并表明即使是先进模型也可能生成错误或缺乏充分依据的解释。

sents.en: LiveCodeBench [ 22 ] provides a continuously updated, contamination-resistant evaluation covering generation, execution, self-repair, and test-output prediction, while BigCodeBench [ 16 ] emphasizes realistic function calls, library usage, and more demanding programming instructions.
sents.zh: LiveCodeBench [ 22 ] 提供了一个持续更新且抗污染的评价体系，涵盖生成、执行、自我修复和测试输出预测；而 BigCodeBench [ 16 ] 则强调真实的函数调用、库的使用以及更具挑战性的编程指令。

sents.en: These benchmarks improve realism and coverage, but their primary objective is broad capability assessment rather than determining how comprehension changes as the internal structure of an individual function becomes more complex.
sents.zh: 这些基准测试提升了真实性和覆盖范围，但它们的主要目标是评估综合能力，而非确定当单个函数的内部结构变得更为复杂时，其理解能力会发生怎样的变化。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level benchmarks address a different source of difficulty. RepoBench [ 23 ] studies code completion with cross-file context, and LongCodeBench [ 24 ] evaluates comprehension and repair under very long context windows. Their results show that retrieval, cross-file dependencies, and context length remain challenging for LLMs. However, contextual scale is different from structural complexity: a model may fail because relevant information is distributed across files, rather than because a single function contains deep nesting, dense branching, or many possible execution paths.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级别的基准测试涉及另一种不同的困难来源。 RepoBench [ 23 ] 研究了跨文件上下文环境下的代码补全，而 LongCodeBench [ 24 ] 则在极长的上下文窗口中评估模型的理解与修复能力。 他们的研究结果表明，信息检索、跨文件依赖以及上下文长度对于大型语言模型而言仍然具有挑战性。 然而，上下文规模与结构复杂性并不相同：模型可能因相关信息分布在多个文件中而失败，而非因为单个函数包含深层嵌套、密集分支或多种可能的执行路径。

paragraphs.en: More recent studies examine complexity and reasoning fidelity more directly. RE2-Bench [ 25 ] evaluates realistic projects containing nested constructs, complex types, and API interactions, but summarizes difficulty using an Easy/Hard division. Mächtle et al. [ 26 ] analyze the relationship between model performance and conventional properties such as lexical size, control-flow complexity, and abstract-syntax-tree structure. Xie et al. [ 27 ] propose LM-CC, a model-perceived complexity measure, and argue that traditional metrics may not fully capture LLM difficulty once code length is controlled. CoRE [ 28 ] additionally shows that a model can predict the correct final result while reasoning incorrectly about intermediate execution states, demonstrating that output-only evaluation may overestimate comprehension.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究更直接地探讨了复杂性与推理保真度。 RE2-Bench [ 25 ] 评估包含嵌套结构、复杂类型和 API 交互的真实项目，但通过“简单/困难”的划分来总结其难度。Mächtle 等人 [ 26 ] 分析了模型性能与词汇量、控制流复杂性和抽象语法树结构等传统属性之间的关系。Xie 等人 [ 27 ] 提出了 LM-CC，一种由模型感知的复杂性度量方法，并认为在控制代码长度后，传统指标可能无法完全捕捉 LLM 的难度。 CoRE [ 28 ] 进一步表明，模型可能在推理中间执行状态时出错，却能预测出正确的最终结果，这说明仅基于输出的评估可能会高估模型的理解能力。

paragraphs.en: Prior work shows that LLM code comprehension is affected by execution demands, semantic reasoning, contextual scale, and program complexity. However, existing studies typically report aggregate accuracy, use a single difficulty label or metric, or rely on one evaluation modality. The present study addresses this gap by analyzing cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume jointly, grouping functions into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands, and combining automatic input–output prediction with manually assessed questions about function purpose, variable roles, and edge-case behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究表明，大型语言模型对代码的理解会受到执行需求、语义推理、上下文规模和程序复杂度的影响。 然而，现有研究通常报告的是总体准确率，使用单一的难度标签或指标，或者仅依赖一种评估方式。 本研究通过联合分析循环复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积，将函数分为低、中、高复杂度三个等级，并结合自动输入输出预测与人工评估的问题（涉及函数目的、变量角色和边界情况行为），来解决这一研究空白。

paragraphs.en: We propose a controlled method for evaluating LLM code comprehension across different levels of structural complexity. Rather than measuring code-generation ability, the method assesses whether a model can infer the behavior and semantics of existing Python functions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种受控方法，用于评估大型语言模型在不同结构复杂度层级上的代码理解能力。 该方法并非衡量代码生成能力，而是评估模型能否推断出已有 Python 函数的行为与语义。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation combines two complementary tasks. In automatic input–output prediction, the model receives a complete function and a concrete function call and must return the exact output. This task provides deterministic ground truth and supports scalable exact-match evaluation. In manual semantic comprehension, the model answers a question about the function’s purpose, the role of an intermediate variable, or edge-case behavior. This task captures semantic understanding that cannot be assessed through exact output prediction alone.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估结合了两项互补的任务。 在自动输入-输出预测中，模型会接收一个完整的函数和一个具体的函数调用，并必须返回精确的输出结果。 这项任务提供了确定性的基准答案，并支持可扩展的精确匹配评估。 在手动语义理解中，模型需要回答关于函数目的、中间变量作用或边界情况行为的问题。 这项任务能够捕捉到仅通过精确输出预测无法评估的语义理解能力。

paragraphs.en: The evaluated functions are organized into Low, Medium, and High-complexity bands, and the same zero-shot protocol is applied to DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf. The method consists of four stages: dataset construction, structural-complexity annotation, model evaluation using standardized prompts, and complexity-aware analysis across bands, dataset sources, task types, and failure patterns.

paragraphs.en: The benchmark contains 300 short, self-contained Python functions collected from HumanEval [ 12 ] , MBPP-sanitized [ 13 ] , CRUXEval [ 11 ] , LeetCode [ 32 ] , and BigCodeBench-Hard [ 16 ] . Python was selected because it is widely represented in code benchmarks and supports reproducible structural analysis through the built-in ast module. HumanEval, MBPP-sanitized, and CRUXEval mainly contribute Low- and Medium-complexity functions, whereas LeetCode and BigCodeBench-Hard provide most of the High-complexity samples.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试包含 300 个简短且自包含的 Python 函数，这些函数分别来自 HumanEval [ 12 ]、MBPP-sanitized [ 13 ]、CRUXEval [ 11 ]、LeetCode [ 32 ] 和 BigCodeBench-Hard [ 16 ]。 选择 Python 的原因在于它在代码基准测试中应用广泛，并且通过内置的 ast 模块支持可重复的结构分析。 HumanEval、MBPP-sanitized 和 CRUXEval 主要贡献了低复杂度和中等复杂度的函数，而 LeetCode 和 BigCodeBench-Hard 则提供了大部分高复杂度的样本。

paragraphs.en: Candidate functions were retained only if they were self-contained, deterministic, executable using the Python standard library, short enough to fit within the prompt, and independent of hidden state, external files, user interaction, randomness, or system-specific behavior. Each selected function was paired with a concrete function call and a ground-truth output obtained through controlled execution. Functions that failed, timed out, produced ambiguous outputs, or required undocumented assumptions were excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 候选函数仅在被满足以下条件时才会被保留：它们是自包含的、确定性的，能够使用 Python 标准库执行，长度足够短以容纳在提示词中，并且不依赖于隐藏状态、外部文件、用户交互、随机性或系统特定的行为。 每个选定的函数都与一个具体的函数调用以及通过受控执行获得的基准输出相匹配。 那些失败、超时、产生模糊输出或需要未记录假设的函数均被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: The manual task evaluates semantic understanding that exact input–output prediction cannot fully capture. paragraphs.en: This section describes how the functions were annotated, how the models were evaluated, and how comprehension performance was analyzed across structural complexity levels.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了函数的标注方法、模型的评估方式，以及跨结构复杂程度水平的理解表现分析方法。

paragraphs.en: To enable complexity-aware analysis, each function in the benchmark is annotated with structural complexity metrics computed through static analysis. These metrics are selected because they capture complementary properties of code structure that are known to affect program comprehension [ 33 , 34 ] . In this study, four metrics are used: cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现对复杂性的感知分析，基准测试中的每个函数都通过静态分析计算出的结构复杂性指标进行了标注。 选择这些指标是因为它们能够捕捉到代码结构的互补特性，而这些特性已知会影响程序理解 [ 33 , 34 ] 。 本研究使用了四个指标：圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积。

sents.en: To enable complexity-aware analysis, each function in the benchmark is annotated with structural complexity metrics computed through static analysis.
sents.zh: 为了实现对复杂性的感知分析，基准测试中的每个函数都通过静态分析计算出的结构复杂性指标进行了标注。

sents.en: These metrics are selected because they capture complementary properties of code structure that are known to affect program comprehension [ 33 , 34 ] .
sents.zh: 选择这些指标是因为它们能够捕捉到代码结构的互补特性，而这些特性已知会影响程序理解 [ 33 , 34 ] 。

sents.en: In this study, four metrics are used: cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume.

In practice, CC is computed by counting decision points such as if , elif , for , while , except , and Boolean operators such as and and or , with a baseline value of 1 for a function with no branching. paragraphs.zh: 其中 E 是控制流图中的边数，N 是节点数，P 是连通分量的数量。 在实践中，CC 通过统计决策点（如 if、elif、for、while、except）和布尔运算符（如 and 和 or）来计算，对于没有分支的函数，其基准值为 1。 较高的 CC 值表示可能的执行路径更多，推理难度也更大。

sents.en: Higher CC values indicate a larger number of possible execution paths and greater reasoning difficulty.
sents.zh: 较高的 CC 值表示可能的执行路径更多，推理难度也更大。

paragraphs.en: Nesting depth (ND) [ 29 ] measures the maximum level of nested control structures within a function, including nested loops, conditionals, and exception-handling blocks. Deeply nested code requires the model to track multiple simultaneous execution contexts, which increases reasoning difficulty and the likelihood of comprehension failure.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌套深度（ND）[ 29 ] 衡量函数内部嵌套控制结构的最大层级，包括嵌套循环、条件判断和异常处理块。 深度嵌套的代码要求模型同时跟踪多个执行上下文，这会提高推理难度并增加理解失败的可能性。

paragraphs.en: Branching factor (BF) [ 27 ] counts the number of decision points in a function, including constructs such as if , for , and while . While CC captures the number of independent execution paths, BF captures how frequently the control flow diverges. This metric therefore reflects the density of local decision-making within the code.
paragraphs.zh: 分支因子（BF）[ 27 ] 用于计算函数中决策点的数量，包括 if、for 和 while 等结构。 CC 衡量的是独立执行路径的数量，而 BF 则衡量控制流发生分歧的频率。 因此，该指标反映了代码内部局部决策的密度。

sents.en: While CC captures the number of independent execution paths, BF captures how frequently the control flow diverges.

paragraphs.en: Halstead volume (HV) [ 31 ] measures lexical and operational complexity based on the number of operators and operands in the function. It captures a different aspect of complexity from control-flow metrics by reflecting the amount of symbolic information that must be interpreted. Higher HV values indicate that the model must process a larger and more varied set of program tokens, variables, and operations.
paragraphs.zh: 哈尔斯泰德体积（HV）[ 31 ] 根据函数中操作符和操作数的数量来衡量词汇和操作的复杂性。 它通过反映必须被解释的符号信息的量，从控制流指标中捕捉到了复杂性的另一个方面。 较高的 HV 值表明模型必须处理更大且更多样的程序令牌、变量和操作集合。

paragraphs.en: For all Python functions, the complexity metrics are computed statically from the parsed source code. Cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, and branching factor are computed using Python’s built-in ast module. Halstead volume is computed from the operators and operands extracted from the same source representation. The raw metric values are retained for statistical analysis, and the functions are also assigned to categorical complexity bands as described in Section IV-A2 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于所有 Python 函数，其复杂度指标均通过静态分析已解析的源代码计算得出。 循环复杂度、嵌套深度和分支因子均使用 Python 内置的 ast 模块进行计算。 哈尔斯泰德体积则基于从同一源代码表示中提取的操作符和操作数计算得出。 原始指标值被保留用于统计分析，同时这些函数也被分配至第 IV-A2 节所述的分类复杂度区间中。

sents.en: For all Python functions, the complexity metrics are computed statically from the parsed source code.
sents.zh: 对于所有 Python 函数，其复杂度指标均通过静态分析已解析的源代码计算得出。

sents.en: Cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, and branching factor are computed using Python’s built-in ast module.
sents.zh: 循环复杂度、嵌套深度和分支因子均使用 Python 内置的 ast 模块进行计算。

sents.en: Halstead volume is computed from the operators and operands extracted from the same source representation.
sents.zh: 哈尔斯泰德体积则基于从同一源代码表示中提取的操作符和操作数计算得出。

sents.en: The raw metric values are retained for statistical analysis, and the functions are also assigned to categorical complexity bands as described in Section IV-A2 .

paragraphs.en: Each function was assigned to a Low-, Medium-, or High-complexity band using cyclomatic complexity and nesting depth as the primary criteria. If the two metrics indicated different bands, the higher band was selected to avoid underestimating structural difficulty. Branching factor and Halstead volume were retained for descriptive and metric-level analyses rather than primary band assignment. Table II summarizes the corresponding ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 每个函数都根据循环复杂度和嵌套深度作为主要标准，被分配到低、中或高复杂度等级。 如果这两个指标指向不同的复杂度等级，则选择较高的等级，以避免低估结构难度。 分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积被保留用于描述性分析和指标层面的分析，而非用于主要的复杂度等级分配。 表 II 总结了相应的范围。

paragraphs.en: Two code-oriented LLMs were evaluated: DeepSeek-Coder-V2 [ 35 ] and CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf [ 36 ] . The models were selected to compare different code-specialized architectures and to examine whether their comprehension accuracy degrades similarly as structural complexity increases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了两款面向代码的大型语言模型：DeepSeek-Coder-V2 [ 35 ] 和 CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf [ 36 ]。 选择这些模型是为了比较不同的代码专用架构，并检验随着结构复杂度的增加，它们的理解准确率是否以相似的方式下降。

paragraphs.en: Both models were evaluated under identical zero-shot conditions using the prompt templates in Sections III-B and III-C . paragraphs.en: For the automatic task, the model returned only the predicted output of the supplied function call, which was evaluated against the executed ground truth. paragraphs.en: For both models, incorrect predictions are associated with higher values of all four metrics. For DeepSeek-Coder-V2, average CC increases from 3.84 to 7.42, ND from 1.72 to 3.46, BF from 3.11 to 6.89, and HV from 142.60 to 318.75. CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf shows the same pattern, with CC increasing from 3.51 to 7.24, ND from 1.58 to 3.32, BF from 2.94 to 6.27, and HV from 131.40 to 297.80. These results indicate that failures are concentrated in functions with more execution paths, deeper control structures, denser branching, and greater symbolic content.

sents.en: For DeepSeek-Coder-V2, average CC increases from 3.84 to 7.42, ND from 1.72 to 3.46, BF from 3.11 to 6.89, and HV from 142.60 to 318.75.

sents.en: These results indicate that failures are concentrated in functions with more execution paths, deeper control structures, denser branching, and greater symbolic content.

paragraphs.en: These findings answer RQ2 by showing that incorrect predictions are systematically associated with greater structural complexity across all measured dimensions. The four metrics can therefore serve as complementary risk indicators: predictions for structurally complex functions should receive additional verification through execution, testing, or human review.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现通过表明不正确的预测在所有测量维度上都系统性地与更高的结构复杂性相关，从而回答了研究问题2（RQ2）。 因此，这四项指标可以用作互补的风险指示器：对于结构复杂的函数，其预测结果应通过执行、测试或人工审查进行额外验证。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 examines whether manual semantic comprehension reveals the same complexity-related reliability limitations observed in automatic input–output prediction. The manual subset evaluates three aspects of semantic understanding: function purpose, intermediate variable roles, and edge-case behavior.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 旨在探究手动语义理解是否揭示了与自动输入-输出预测中观察到的相同复杂性相关的可靠性限制。 手动子集评估了语义理解的三个方面：功能目的、中间变量的作用以及边界情况的行为。

paragraphs.en: To illustrate the distinction between automatic and manual evaluation, consider the Candy function from the LeetCode subset, shown in figure 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了说明自动评估与手动评估之间的区别，可以考虑 LeetCode 子集中的 Candy 函数，如圖 3 所示。

paragraphs.en: This function belongs to the Medium-complexity band, with cyclomatic complexity of 5, nesting depth of 3, branching factor of 4, and Halstead volume of 136.0. In the automatic task, the model predicts the output of a call such as min_candies([1,0,2]) , whose return value is 5 . In the manual task, the model may instead be asked: What is the role of the variable candies ? A correct answer must explain that the variable stores the allocation for each child and is updated through two directional passes to satisfy the neighboring rating constraints. Thus, the manual task evaluates understanding of the algorithm’s internal state rather than only its final output.
paragraphs.zh: 该函数属于中等复杂度级别，其圈复杂度为 5，嵌套深度为 3，分支因子为 4，哈尔斯泰德体积为 136.0。 在自动任务中，模型会预测某个调用的输出，例如 min_candies([1,0,2])，其返回值为 5。 在手动任务中，模型可能会被这样提问：变量 candies 的作用是什么？ 正确的答案必须解释该变量存储了每个孩子的分配量，并且通过两个方向的遍历进行更新，以满足相邻评分约束。 因此，手动任务评估的是对算法内部状态的理解，而不仅仅是其最终输出。

paragraphs.en: To estimate the joint association between structural complexity and automatic prediction correctness, we fitted the multivariate logistic regression model defined in Equation 3 . paragraphs.en: The results demonstrate that benchmark composition is an important factor in interpreting LLM code-comprehension performance. HumanEval, MBPP-sanitized, and CRUXEval contain only Low- and Medium-complexity functions in the constructed benchmark and consequently produce higher model accuracy. In contrast, LeetCode and BigCodeBench-Hard contain most of the High-complexity functions and expose substantially lower reliability. This indicates that differences between benchmark scores cannot always be attributed only to model capability. They may also reflect differences in the structural-complexity distribution of the evaluated code. Reporting benchmark-level accuracy without this distribution can therefore conceal important reliability limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，基准测试的构成是解读大型语言模型（LLM）代码理解性能的重要因素。 HumanEval、MBPP-sanitized 和 CRUXEval 在构建的基准测试中仅包含低复杂度和中等复杂度的函数，因此能产生更高的模型准确率。 相比之下，LeetCode 和 BigCodeBench-Hard 包含了大部分高复杂度的函数，从而暴露出明显更低的可靠性。 这表明，基准测试分数之间的差异并不总能完全归因于模型能力本身。 这些差异也可能反映了所评估代码在结构复杂度分布上的不同。 因此，在不提供这种分布信息的情况下报告基准测试级别的准确率，可能会掩盖重要的可靠性限制。

paragraphs.en: The metric-level findings provide a complementary interpretation. Cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume were all negatively associated with prediction correctness. Although cyclomatic complexity and branching factor had numerically large associations, their confidence intervals overlapped with those of the other metrics. The results therefore do not establish a single dominant measure of LLM comprehension difficulty. Instead, the four metrics capture different but related reasoning demands: execution-path diversity, hierarchical control flow, decision density, and symbolic processing load. Their joint use provides a more complete indication of when an LLM response may require verification.
paragraphs.zh: 指标层面的发现提供了补充性的解释。 圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积均与预测准确性呈负相关。 尽管圈复杂度和分支因子的数值相关性较大，但它们的置信区间与其他指标的置信区间存在重叠。 因此，这些结果并未确立衡量 LLM 理解难度的单一主导指标。 相反，这四项指标分别捕捉了不同但相关的推理需求：执行路径多样性、层级控制流、决策密度和符号处理负荷。 联合使用这些指标能更完整地指示 LLM 的响应在何种情况下可能需要验证。

paragraphs.en: The difference between automatic and manual performance also provides insight into how models process source code. Automatic input–output prediction showed a larger Low-to-High accuracy decline than manual semantic comprehension. Exact prediction requires the model to follow a specific execution path and preserve every intermediate state until the final return value is produced. A single error in loop simulation, conditional evaluation, or variable updating leads to an incorrect answer. Manual questions may sometimes be answered through recognition of the function’s overall structure or algorithmic pattern. Nevertheless, their accuracy also declined with complexity, confirming that the effect extends beyond exact-match scoring to semantic understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 自动执行与手动执行之间的差异也有助于我们了解模型如何处理源代码。 在自动输入-输出预测中，从低复杂度到高复杂度的准确率下降幅度大于手动语义理解的情况。 精确预测要求模型遵循特定的执行路径，并保留所有中间状态，直到生成最终的返回值。 循环模拟、条件判断或变量更新中的任何一处错误都会导致错误的答案。 对于手动问题，有时可以通过识别函数的整体结构或算法模式来作答。 尽管如此，随着复杂度的增加，它们的准确率同样有所下降，这证实了这种影响不仅限于精确匹配评分，也涉及语义理解。

paragraphs.en: These findings have practical implications for LLM-assisted software engineering. Structural metrics can be computed before an LLM is asked to explain, review, or predict the behavior of a function. When the code contains deep nesting, many decision points, or high symbolic complexity, a development tool could request additional test execution, generate a warning, or recommend human review. Complexity-aware verification may therefore provide a lightweight mechanism for identifying situations in which model output should not be accepted without further checking.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现对大型语言模型辅助的软件工程具有实际意义。 在要求大型语言模型解释、审查或预测函数行为之前，就可以计算结构指标。 当代码包含深层嵌套、大量决策点或高符号复杂性时，开发工具可以请求执行额外测试、生成警告或建议人工审查。 因此，具备复杂性意识的验证可能提供了一种轻量级机制，用于识别那些模型输出不应未经进一步检查就接受的情况。

paragraphs.en: Several threats limit the generalizability of the findings. The benchmark contains only Python functions, and languages with different typing, memory, or control-flow characteristics may produce different results. The evaluation includes two code-oriented models under zero-shot, deterministic prompting, so the findings may change with larger models, few-shot prompting, tool use, or explicit reasoning instructions. The Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity thresholds provide a practical operationalization of structural difficulty but do not capture semantic factors such as unfamiliar APIs, recursion, or domain-specific logic. Widely used benchmarks may also occur in model training data. Finally, the manual evaluation contains 60 functions and relies on human judgement, although balanced sampling, a fixed binary rubric, and strong inter-rater agreement reduce this risk.

paragraphs.en: This paper presented a complexity-aware method for evaluating LLM code comprehension using automatic input–output prediction and manual semantic comprehension. Python functions were annotated with cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume and grouped into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands. This design provides a more diagnostic view of model reliability than aggregate benchmark accuracy alone.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种考虑复杂性的方法，通过自动输入-输出预测和手动语义理解来评估大型语言模型对代码的理解能力。 对 Python 函数标注了循环复杂性、嵌套深度、分支因子和哈尔斯泰德体积，并将其分为低、中、高复杂性三个等级。 与仅依赖基准测试的汇总准确率相比，这种设计能更清晰地诊断模型的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: The results show that both DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf become substantially less accurate as structural complexity increases. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 decreased from 93.52% accuracy on Low-complexity functions to 52.78% on High-complexity functions, while CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf decreased from 87.04% to 47.22%. Incorrect predictions were associated with higher values of all four complexity metrics, and both correlation and multivariate logistic-regression analyses confirmed negative associations between structural complexity and correctness. Because the effect estimates and confidence intervals overlapped, the metrics are best interpreted as complementary indicators of comprehension risk rather than as a strict ranking of predictors.

sents.zh: 两种模型在目的性问题上表现最佳，在边缘案例问题上表现最差，同时准确率也从低复杂度函数向高复杂度函数逐渐下降。

sents.en: These findings indicate that structural complexity affects both exact execution reasoning and higher-level semantic understanding.
sents.zh: 这些发现表明，结构复杂性既会影响精确执行推理，也会影响更高层级的语义理解。

paragraphs.en: Complexity distribution should be reported alongside aggregate accuracy when evaluating LLM code comprehension. In practical software engineering workflows, model explanations, predictions, and review suggestions should receive additional verification when applied to code with deep nesting, many execution paths, dense branching, or high symbolic complexity. Future work should extend this evaluation to other programming languages, larger model families, repository-level code, and tool-assisted comprehension settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估 LLM 的代码理解能力时，应同时报告复杂度分布和总体准确率。 在实际的软件工程工作流程中，当模型解释、预测和审查建议应用于具有深层嵌套、多条执行路径、密集分支或高符号复杂度的代码时，应进行额外验证。 未来的工作应将此评估扩展到其他编程语言、更大的模型系列、仓库级别的代码以及借助工具的理解场景。
